$doc: §23.6 ST-0. A scenario Order verb checks the order against the PHYSICAL class table before it publishes (a rifle squad has no Strike - 'no behaviour' - so no event would exist); an ARTILLERY BATTERY does (ArtilleryUnitStrike), so the order is published and the receiver's stochastic table refuses it (B-6, B-8). The company hears the refusal as a CommandReportHistory row (it holds no CommandPicture - it ordered nothing).

expect.name: the battery runs no stochastic play
